items.title: David Njoku (shoulder) was held out of Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Playing in his just his second game off I.R., Njoku suffered the upper-body injury against the Jets last Sunday. We already had practically nonexistent expectations for Njoku becoming TE2 relevant, but the new issue coupled with DJ Uiagalelei’s likely Week 12 start has him further from 12-team league lineups than ever. - Patrick Daugherty

items.title: Keaton Mitchell (knee) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Mitchell was listed as a DNP for the Chargers’ Wednesday walk-through. He suffered the knee injury in the first half of the team’s Week 11 loss to the Jets, only playing on a kick return afterwards and exiting the game in the second half. Mitchell does not need to be in fantasy lineups, though a potential absence would further boost Omarion Hampton’s resurgence for Week 12 against the Patriots. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Quenton Nelson (knee) and Abraham Lucas (ankle) are out for Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.text: Neither Nelson or Lucas practiced on Wednesday and Macdonald declared both offensive lineman out this week against the 49ers. The Seahawks will dig into their offensive line depth to deal with the 49ers pass rush this week. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Drew Lock (right elbow) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Lock continues to deal with an elbow injury, getting in a limited session on Wednesday. Sam Darnold was practicing in full and already announced to start in Week 12, so Lock can go back to fantasy benches and be cut for other waiver wire adds or stashes. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Smith-Njigba was listed on the practice report with an ankle issue earlier this season, but has not missed a game. This is likely just load management for the 24-year-old receiver. Expect Smith-Njigba to still play in Week 12 against the 49ers. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Hunter is dealing with a hamstring strain, missing the past two games for the Texans. He starts out this week not practicing and will need to practice in some capacity to have a shot at returning in Week 12 against the Ravens. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Kayshon Boutte (hip) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Boutte popped up on the injury report with a hip issue and did not practice Wednesday. With Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) potentially returning this week, Boutte does not need to be on the fantasy radar for Week 12 against the Ravens. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Rashod Bateman (groin) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Bateman was hobbled after taking a hard hit in the Ravens’ Week 11 loss to the Panthers. He pops up on the injury report with a groin issue to start the week, though he was still limited in practice. Bateman is hardly fantasy relevant at this point, but an absence would indicate more Ja’Kobi Lane targets for Week 12 against the Texans. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Zay Flowers (ankle) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Flowers dealt with ankle issues earlier this season and now pops up on the injury report with a limited designation due to the ankle. He is still trending to play in Week 12, where he will operate as the Ravens’ WR1 for Jacoby Brissett against the Texans. Barring setbacks, the ankle should not limit Flowers too much as he sits in the WR2 rankings this week. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Rams declared QB Ty Simpson, DE Larrell Murchison, OLB Darryl Peterson III, C Coleman Shelton, G Steve Avila, and OLB Desjuan Johnson inactive for Week 12 against the Packers.
items.text: Simpson will operate as the team’s emergency third quarterback. Avila and Shelton were declared out heading into the day, leaving the Rams offensive line short-handed against a Packers defensive line getting Micah Parsons back. - Aditya Fuldeore
